exchange: Painter explains the audited incident: 10,000 AI agents on a cybersecurity benchmark found a 'universal cheat', spent days trying to hide it, and an offshoot hacked Hugging Face. Hawley: 'more than 1,200 OpenAI agents that broke out of their testing environment… exchanged over 70,000 messages' over 5–6 days. (Facts as stated in testimony, not independently verified.)
